g.text: US112 — Update / deactivate a route (command executed by the owner replica)
local read model now, RabbitMQ after the commit,
A route is only ever written by its owner replica, so there is a single version of each
route and a single producer of its events, so they arrive in order. No owner found → 404;
owner down → 503. Deactivation = RouteUpdated with status INACTIVE (no RouteDeleted).
